t: What a planted thing keeps earning
a: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ غَرَسَ غَرْسًا فَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ إِنْسَانٌ أَوْ دَابَّةٌ إِلاَّ كَانَ لَهُ صَدَقَةً
p: Mā min muslimin gharasa gharsan fa-akala minhu insānun aw dābbatun illā kāna lahu ṣadaqah
m: There is no Muslim who plants a plant, and a human being or an animal eats from it, but that it is charity for him.
